verdict.rationale: Base44 supports GitHub sync for code version control (which would include workflow/agent config files) and defines agent behavior in local JSONC config files, implying some git-based versioning, but there is no explicit feature for reviewing execution history or rolling back automations/workflows specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated automation run history/audit log, an in-app rollback mechanism for workflows, and any review UI for automation changes beyond generic GitHub diffs.
